title: AI News Daily — September 7, 2026
summary: OpenAI's chief scientist calls AI an 'alien mind' the field can't fully monitor, even as the company discloses its own research agents now outpace human researchers. Meanwhile, Zuckerberg privately lobbied Trump against a proposed AI safety regulator. And corporate America is quietly defecting to open models — AT&T alone has cut its OpenAI and Anthropic bills by up to 80% on the applications it's moved.
